::: {#exr-which-are-linear}

#### Which of these are linear in $\vec w$?

Each of the five expressions is a function of the weights
$\vec w \in \mathbb{R}^D$,
with the data $\vec x$ and $y$ held fixed.
Say which ones have the form @eq-linear-scalar --- an inner product plus an
offset --- and which do not.

1.  $\vec w^\top \vec x$
2.  $\vec w^\top \vec x - y$
3.  $(\vec w^\top \vec x - y)^2$
4.  $\lVert \vec w \rVert_2^2$
5.  $w_1 x_1 + 3$

:::
